spans.s:
युष्मत् (e युष्म, euphonice pro युस्म, et ablativi signo त्)
pronominis 2^dae pers. ablat. plur., qui in initio compositorum
Thematis loco fungitur et a grammaticis tanquam
Thema proponitur; scribunt tamen युष्मद्. (Cf. aeol.
ὔμμες per assimil. ex ὔσμες; goth. IZVA, correpto ju
in i (nom. jus), mutato m in v, v. gr. 265. gr. comp. 167. 334. 335.; v. sq.)

युष्मे nom. pl. pronom. 2^dae pers. in. dial. Vêd. (Zend. yûs,
lith. jûs, goth. jus, germ. vet. ir, correpto ju in i, mutato
s in r; v. युष्मत् et gr. comp. 335.)

यूष् 1. P. (हिंसायाम् वधे) ferire, laedere, occidere. V.
जूष्.

यूष m. n. jus pisinum; Wils. «pease soup, pease porridge,
the water in which pulse of various kinds has been boiled».
(Lat. jûs, jûr-is e jûs-is.)
